themes.known_en: Lockheed Martin: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. RTX: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. Northrop Grumman reported a 68 USD million unfavorable SiAW estimate-at-completion adjustment for Q2 2026. The same disclosure projects higher costs to mature AARGM-ER production and to develop and qualify SiAW, and reports a favorable Sentinel adjustment tied to contract incentives as a partial offset. This is disclosed cost and execution context, not installed capacity, unit throughput or future profitability. LMT Missiles and Fire Control 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 4101.0 USD million, operating profit 594.0 USD million, margin 14.5 %. RTX Raytheon 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 8269.0 USD million, operating profit 1042.0 USD million, margin 12.6 %.

themes.known_en: Northrop Grumman: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. L3Harris Technologies: reported segment evidence is available for 2026Q2. It is not program workshare or shareholder capture. L3Harris reports the completed majority sale of its commercial space propulsion, power and electronics businesses; broad space demand cannot be attributed wholly to LHX after the sale. This is ownership context, not a measured revenue loss. L3Harris reports approximately 40% retained ownership in Rocketdyne and excludes RS-25 operations from the sale. Ownership share is not program workshare or revenue share. NOC Defense Systems 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 2093.0 USD million, operating profit 156.0 USD million, margin 7.5 %. LHX Missile Solutions 2026Q2 reported baseline: sales 1054.0 USD million, operating profit 130.0 USD million, margin 12.3 %.
themes.known_zh: Northrop Grumman：已有2026Q2报告分部证据。它不代表项目份额或股东获益。 L3Harris Technologies：已有2026Q2报告分部证据。它不代表项目份额或股东获益。 L3Harris披露已完成商业航天推进、电力及电子业务的多数股权出售；出售后不能将广泛航天需求全部归于LHX。这属于所有权背景，未量化收入损失。 L3Harris披露保留Rocketdyne约40%的股权，RS-25业务不在出售范围内。股权比例不等于项目份额或收入份额。 NOC Defense Systems 2026Q2报告基准：销售额 2093.0 百万美元、营业利润 156.0 百万美元、利润率 7.5 %。 LHX Missile Solutions 2026Q2报告基准：销售额 1054.0 百万美元、营业利润 130.0 百万美元、利润率 12.3 %。
